content.headline: Weak Prompt vs Enterprise Prompt
content.body: A vague question gets a vague answer. A clear, structured prompt gets you a draft you can actually use.
bullets: Weak: "Write a letter about land records" → a generic essay nobody would sign
Enterprise: Role + Context + Task + Constraints + Format → a draft ready to review
The difference is not luck. It is structure, and you can learn it in five minutes.
